verdict.rationale: Docs describe the exact developer flow: create applicant/workflow run server-side with API token, obtain SDK token, use hosted (Smart Capture Link) or embedded SDK to collect document+selfie captures, then retrieve results via webhook or polling — no custom capture UI needed. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration (e.g. third-party tutorials or reviews) confirming the flow works end-to-end in practice.
